name: AAA Travel Advantage Visa Signature Credit Card

localized_names.en: AAA Travel Advantage Visa Signature Credit Card

apr.notes: Variable Purchase APR of 17.49% - 31.49% based on your credit worthiness at the time of account opening and the Prime Rate. Variable Cash Advance APR of 32.49%, based on Prime Rate. Minimum Interest Charge is $3.00. Balance Transfer Fee of the greater of $10 or 5% of the transfer. Cash Advance Fee of the greater of $10 or 5% of the advance.

fx_fee.notes: 0% foreign transaction fees stated on page.

base_rate.description: 1% cash back on all other purchases

rewards.redemption_notes: Cash back can be redeemed as statement credits, direct deposit, rewards and qualifying purchases at participating AAA locations. This rewards program is provided by Comenity Capital Bank.

benefits.title: No Foreign Transaction Fee
benefits.description: 0% fees Foreign transaction fees — you won't be charged a foreign transaction fee when you travel abroad.

benefits.title: Double Cash Back on Member First Purchases
benefits.description: Earn double cash back on all Member First purchases when you use your AAA Visa Signature credit card. AAA Travel Advantage cardholders earn 6% (normally 3%). Valid for AAA members on purchases made at AAA or directly with Member First. Offer valid 6/1/26 - 6/30/26.
